name: Anita
source:
Anita is Dia's stepmother. She is obsessed with Dia's singing voice. Anita has been relentlessly trying to find Dia after he escaped from her and hid at the academy.

[From [url=https://court-of-darkness.fandom.com/wiki/Anita]Fandom Wiki[/url]]
